evidence.claim: Official page states that the upper tower is divided into seven equal orange/white paint bands. No photograph is packaged or used as a texture.

Existing color(z) specifies 154 + (333-154)/7 boundaries. Upper lattice currently chooses one material for a whole member using its midpoint; this change implements the existing intended bands across the member surfaces.

limits: 154 m bottom and exact boundary elevations are inherited model estimates, not newly surveyed real-world elevations.
Existing geometry silhouette and palette are retained; no claim of exact paint color, as-built section dimensions or antenna accuracy.
Only the two structural paint meshes are changed; deck, interior, auxiliary vegetation and city placement are outside scope.
